records.title: Haze Situation Update (15 October 2026)

records.title: Haze Situation Update (9 October 2026)
records.summary: 24-hour PSI of 135–192 at 6pm and an Unhealthy to Low Very Unhealthy forecast, with haze from southern and central Sumatra and parts of Kalimantan.

records.title: ASMC Alerts
